headlines.text: It was 2025 when Kenny Omega vs. Brody King vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Mascara Dorada fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.45 ? a real highlight of the night. It was the first title opportunity of Mascara Dorada's career. In a hard-hitting four-way also involving Brody King and Mascara Dorada, Omega retained the AEW International Championship over Claudio Castagnoli.
Back on this day in 2021, PAC & Penta made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.02 ? a solid showing.
On this day in 2025, JetSpeed touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.79 ? a good, competitive contest.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2025, when Nick Wayne vs. AR Fox vs. Lee Johnson vs. Sammy Guevara went to battle over the ROH World TV Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.16. It was the 10th time the ROH World TV Title had been on the line, a notable milestone for the title.
2025 brought us this moment: Hechicero, Fletcher & Takeshita kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.65.
2025 brought us this moment: Atlantis & Templario touched down in AEW for the first time as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 7.11 ? a good, competitive contest.
